# rustinion_notification_route (Resource)

Routes a rustinion_notification_channel to the findings it should receive. "tag"-scoped routes only ever match device-scoped compliance findings (disk/CPU/memory/patch-compliance and similar) — never an alert-rule/log-alert/SNMP-trap/SLO/synthetic-check finding, which has no device tags of its own. A route's scope is immutable; changing any attribute destroys and recreates it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the rustinion_notification_channel this route applies to.
- `scope` (String) One of "tenant", "group", "rule", or "tag".

### Optional

- `scope_id` (String) The group ID (scope = "group") or alert-rule ID (scope = "rule") this route applies to. Unused for "tenant"/"tag".
- `tag` (String) The device tag (scope = "tag") this route matches on — e.g. "production". Unused for every other scope. Matches a device-scoped finding whose device carries this exact tag; never matches an alert-rule/log-alert/SNMP-trap/SLO/synthetic-check-driven finding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned route ID.
